answer: Snapshot as of October 3, 2026. (1) September 30, 2026: Cal-Maine reported fiscal Q1 2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026): net sales USD 539.6 million (-41.5% from USD 922.6 million), gross profit USD 0.4 million, operating loss USD 82.2 million and a net loss attributable of USD 58.6 million, or USD 1.26 per diluted share, versus net income of USD 199.3 million (USD 4.12) a year earlier [H20-E1][H20-E3]. (3) Buybacks: 66,601 shares for USD 5.0 million in the quarter (USD 315.7 million left of the USD 500 million program) and 204,888 shares for USD 14.9 million after quarter end [H20-E1]. (4) On August 31, 2026 (8-K filed September 2) the company entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement: a five-year senior unsecured revolver of up to USD 250 million (accordion up to another USD 250 million), maturing August 31, 2031, with nothing borrowed at September 1 [H20-E2]. **Question:** What has Cal-Maine Foods reported or announced in the 30 days before October 3, 2026 about its quarterly results, shareholder returns and financing? Give dates and key figures.
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** 'In the 30 days before October 3, 2026' read as the window 2026-09-03 to 2026-10-03. Cal-Maine Foods read as Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. (CALM), the SEC registrant; fiscal year ends late May/early June, so period labels are fiscal, not calendar. The only quarter reported inside the window is Q1 FY2027 (2026-05-31 to 2026-08-29), released and filed 2026-09-30; Q2 FY2027 is still in progress and not reported. 'Quarterly results' read as the Q1 FY2027 headline results (net sales, operating income/margin, net income, diluted EPS) with prior-year comparison. 'Shareholder returns' read as dividends declared/paid and any share repurchase activity or buyback authorization in the window. 'Financing' read as any new or amended credit facility, debt issuance/repayment or other capital-structure action announced in the window.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 FY2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026) | 539,607 [1][2] | 403 [1][2] | (82,165) [1][2] | (15.2) [1] | (58,615) [1][2] | (1.26) [1][2] |
| Q1 FY2026 (13 weeks ended August 30, 2025) | 922,602 [1][2] | 311,314 [1][2] | 249,184 [1][2] | 27.0 [1] | 199,340 [1][2] | 4.12 [1][2] |

- Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. (Nasdaq: CALM) reported its first quarter fiscal 2027 results on September 30, 2026, for the quarter ended August 29, 2026, with all comparisons to the comparable period of fiscal 2026. [1][3]
- Q1 FY2027 net sales were $539,607 thousand versus $922,602 thousand in Q1 FY2026, a decrease of $382,995 thousand, or 41.5% as disclosed. [1][2]
- Q1 FY2027 operating income (loss) was $(82,165) thousand versus operating income of $249,184 thousand in Q1 FY2026, a change of $(331,349) thousand, or (133.0)% as disclosed. [1][2]
- Q1 FY2027 net income (loss) attributable to Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. was $(58,615) thousand versus $199,340 thousand in Q1 FY2026, a change of $(257,955) thousand, or (129.4)% as disclosed. [1][2]
- Q1 FY2027 diluted loss per share was $(1.26) versus diluted EPS of $4.12 in Q1 FY2026, a change of $(5.38), or (130.6)% as disclosed. [1][2]
- Q1 FY2027 gross profit was $403 thousand versus $311,314 thousand in Q1 FY2026, a decrease of $310,911 thousand, or (99.9)% as disclosed. [1][2]
- The company said Q1 FY2027 results reflected an abundantly supplied egg market following industry layer flock repopulation during fiscal 2026, with conventional shell egg prices substantially lower than the prior-year period. [1]
- Under its variable dividend policy, Cal-Maine Foods stated it will not pay a cash dividend with respect to the first quarter of fiscal 2027. [1]
- The company said it will not pay a dividend for a subsequent profitable quarter until it is profitable on a cumulative basis computed from the date of the last quarter in which a dividend was paid, and that as of August 29, 2026 a cumulative loss remained to be recovered before payment of any future dividend. [1]
- Cal-Maine Foods repurchased 66,601 shares of its common stock under its current share repurchase authorization during the first quarter of fiscal 2027 for a total of $5.0 million. [1][3]
- The repurchase program permits repurchases of up to $500 million, of which $315.7 million remained available as of the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2027 (August 29, 2026). [1][3]
- Subsequent to the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Cal-Maine Foods repurchased 204,888 shares under the repurchase program for $14.9 million. [1][3]
- On August 31, 2026, Cal-Maine Foods entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (announced in an 8-K filed September 2, 2026) providing for a senior unsecured revolving credit facility of up to $250 million, which amends and restates its existing Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated November 15, 2021. [4]
- The new credit facility has a five-year term maturing on August 31, 2031, includes a $25 million sublimit for standby letters of credit and a $25 million sublimit for swingline loans, and includes an accordion feature permitting an increase of up to $250 million in the aggregate. [4]
- As of September 1, 2026, no amounts were borrowed under the new credit facility and $5.9 million in standby letters of credit were issued under it. [4]
- The new credit agreement requires maintenance of two financial covenants: a maximum Total Funded Debt to Capitalization Ratio tested quarterly of no greater than 50%, and Minimum Tangible Net Worth at all times of $1.5 billion plus 50% of consolidated net income (if positive) less permitted restricted payments for each fiscal quarter after May 30, 2026. [4]
- Cal-Maine Foods announced on September 9, 2026 that it would report its fiscal 2027 first quarter results at approximately 6:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, with a conference call and webcast at 9:00 a.m. ET the same day. [5][6]
